recentItems.title: Why does a custom class work correct in a static class property but not in an instance property?
recentItems.content:
I have created a custom class. And one of the properties of this class is an associative list of objects with a different custom class.

The weird problem I am running into, is that the objects in the list of the static property work fine, in that they keep their custom class. But they do not work correctly when I assign that same assoc. list to an instance variable.

So:

export default class Sound {
  static TRACKS: { [trackKey: string]: CustomTrackClass } = { ... };

works fine. I can get a single object from TRACKS, and it still has the custom class. And I can call on a method in this CustomTrackClass objectt without problems.

However:

export default class Sound {
  public TRACKS: { [trackKey: string]: CustomTrackClass } = { ... };

Does not work correctly. If I request a single CustomTrackClass object from the assoc. list, it is returned as a standard object. And when I try to call on a method of that CustomTrackClass object, I get "methodX is not a function".

What am I missing here?

recentItems.title: Show HN: A map of cafes that are in the sun
recentItems.content:
I wanted to sit outside for coffee but there was no way to see which cafes are in the sun right now. So I built a map that shows which cafes, benches, and outdoor seats are in the sun vs. shade at any time of day.

It ray-marches building shadows live in a WebGL shader over a MapLibre map. I also pre-index all places from OpenStreetMap into H3 hex cells and serve them as static JSON on Cloudflare R2, so the client just fetches the cells in view and no backend is needed.
